description: HMAC-SHA256 webhook signing contract: sign = hex(HMAC-SHA256(key, timestamp + "." + body)). Shared across Java, Node and Python. Verify cases use the first vector: a matching signature with tolerance 0, the same signature against a one-byte-changed body, and the original timestamp with the default 300 s replay window (which rejects it because 1700000000 is far in the past).

vectors.description: non-json plain text payload, zero timestamp
